title: Tree Tap - Resin
description: Datapack for the tree tapper mod so that you can tap any block to make any item
body:
This is a data pack for the tree tap mod found here -   [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/treetap)    [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/treetap)

Source code provided by JDKDigital (Author of tree tap) - https://github.com/JDKDigital/treetap

Report bugs / suggestions in my [Discord](https://discord.gg/vrekW2ZPbp)

available for anyone to use / modify, do what you want with it no credit required, distribute all you want.
